game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when mischievous imps strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when mischievous imps strike. Each round, mischievous imps strike the signal beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the signal beacon from mischievous imps in Throne Hall: keep the b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Throne Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Throne Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while b > 0.
